observations.behavior: Wraps pending events in a deduplication function before processing. This collapses superseded tool call updates into one merged snapshot rather than emitting each intermediate state separately.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces redundant or conflicting telemetry entries for agent sessions, potentially improving signal quality and reducing storage/compute load on warehouse-side consumers.

observations.posthog_connection: Reinforces reliability across different execution boundaries, preventing partial or duplicate snapshots from reaching PostHog's backend.
